jobs.title: Head of Application Development
jobs.description:
RaySearch develops innovative software solutions to improve cancer care. Over 1200 clinics in more than 54 countries use RaySearch software to improve treatments and quality of life for patients. RaySearch was founded in 2000 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. The headquarters is located in Stockholm, with subsidiaries in the US, Europe, Asia and Australia & New Zealand. Today we are more than 485 employees with a common vision of improving cancer care with innovative software. Our great staff is crucial for our success and we offer a fantastic working environment in modern offices, flexibility and good opportunities for development. We believe in equal opportunities, value diversity and work actively to prevent discrimination.

**Vill du vara med och leda utvecklingen av mjukvara som gör skillnad för cancerpatienter världen över?**

På RaySearch kombinerar vi avancerad teknik med ett tydligt syfte: att förbättra cancervården genom innovativ mjukvara som används på cancerkliniker världen över. Hos oss får du möjlighet att kombinera ett starkt teknikintresse med ett meningsfullt uppdrag, där ditt ledarskap bidrar till att göra skillnad för människor varje dag.

Nu genomför vi en förändring inom vår utvecklingsorganisation och söker två erfarna ledare till våra nya sektioner Application Development 1 och Application Development 2. Rollerna är centrala i arbetet med att stärka och vidareutveckla vår applikationsutveckling. Tillsammans ansvarar ni för att bygga en stark, skalbar och högpresterande utvecklingsorganisation med fokus på förbättringsarbete, kompetensutveckling, samarbete och leverans. Som en del av vår nya linjeorganisation med fem sektioner inom utvecklingsavdelningen kommer ni att arbeta nära de övriga sektionerna som ansvarar för produktutvecklingens inriktning och genomförande, produkternas säkerhet och validering samt fysik och algoritmutveckling.

**Om rollen**

Som Head of Application Development ansvarar du för att utveckla organisationen bakom RaySearchs produkter vilka inkluderar RayStation, ett avancerat dosplaneringssystem för strålbehandling, och RayCare, ett innovativt onkologiskt informationssystem som stödjer hela cancerbehandlingsprocessen. Vi arbetar med en modern teknikstack som bland annat omfattar C#, .NET, SQL Server, WPF och React.

Du rapporterar till Director of Development och leder ett antal gruppchefer. Hur ansvar och direktrapporter fördelas mellan de två rollerna avgörs utifrån verksamhetens behov och de personer som tillträder tjänsterna. Ni arbetar nära varandra för att utveckla både era sektioner och avdelningen som helhet.

I rollen som Head of Application Development leder du arbetet med att sätta riktningen för applikationsutvecklingen och ser till att organisationen har förmågan att omsätta den i väl fungerande produkter. Det innebär bland annat att:

* Utforma och kommunicera strategi för mjukvaruarkitektur, designprinciper och teknisk inriktning.
* Skapa arbetssätt och styrning som bidrar till hög kvalitet och lösningar som är enkla att vidareutveckla och kan växa med behoven.
* Driva förbättringsarbete kring utvecklingsprocesser, verktyg, utvecklarnas produktivitet och användningen av AI.
* Bygga långsiktig teknisk kompetens utifrån verksamhetens och produkternas behov.
* Säkerställa rätt bemanning, kompetens och organisatoriska förutsättningar för framgångsrik produktutveckling.
* Stärka samarbetet mellan team och funktioner så att gemensamma prioriteringar får genomslag.
* Leda och utveckla chefer och tekniska ledare.

**Din profil**

Du är en erfaren ledare med bakgrund från avancerad mjukvaruutveckling. Genom din tekniska kompetens och förståelse för mjukvaruarkitektur, utvecklingsprocesser och tekniska vägval kan du bidra till både strategiska beslut och operativ utveckling. Du kan förena långsiktig teknisk strategi med de praktiska förutsättningar som krävs för att team ska kunna leverera med hög kvalitet.

Vi söker dig som har en masterexamen (M.Sc.) eller likvärdig utbildning och som kommunicerar obehindrat på både svenska och engelska i tal och skrift. Du har gedigen erfarenhet av att driva processförbättringar och öka operativ effektivitet samt ett starkt fokus på resultat, kvalitet och genomförande. Meriterande är om du har erfarenhet av att jobba med medicinskteknisk mjukvara eller inom en annan reglerad verksamhet.

Som ledare har du mycket god kommunikativ förmåga och kan på ett trovärdigt sätt bygga engagemang, skapa samsyn och förmedla både strategiska och tekniska budskap till olika målgrupper. Du driver förändring och får människor med olika kompetenser att lyckas tillsammans. Du trivs i en prestigelös miljö där framgång skapas genom samarbete, kunskapsdelning och gemensamt ansvarstagande.

**Ansökan**

Du är välkommen att söka tjänsten genom formuläret nedan. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via mail men har du frågor kring tjänsten är du välkommen att höra av dig till rekryterande chef Henrik Friberger, henrik.friberger@raysearchlabs.com

jobs.title: IT cum Website Design and Developer
jobs.description:
Duties and responsibilities
  
  
Design, develop, and deploy front-end web interfaces using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern frameworks such as React or Angular
  
  
Build and maintain back-end APIs and server-side logic using Node.js, Python, Java, or .NET depending on the stack
  
  
Integrate web applications with enterprise databases, authentication systems, and third-party APIs
  
  
**Participate in agile sprints:** write user stories, estimate tasks, attend standups, and deliver working code on schedule
  
  
Review and test code written by peers through pull requests, unit tests, and integration test suites
  
  
Diagnose and resolve production bugs, performance bottlenecks, and cross-browser compatibility issues
  
  
Maintain documentation for application architecture, APIs, deployment procedures, and configuration settings
  
  
Apply OWASP security principles and remediate vulnerabilities flagged in static analysis or penetration testing
  
  
Coordinate with IT infrastructure and DevOps teams to deploy applications through CI/CD pipelines to cloud or on-premises environments
  
  
Translate requirements from business analysts and stakeholders into technical specifications and working web features

jobs.title: Senior Software Verification Engineer
jobs.description:
Change people’s lives and love what you do! Cochlear develops world-leading medical devices that help people hear. As a top 100 medical device company and market-leader in implantable hearing devices, more people choose a Cochlear-branded cochlear implant system than any other. Our employees tell us that the number one reason they enjoy working for Cochlear is the opportunity to make a difference to people’s lives.

We're looking for a **Senior Software Verification Engineer** who is passionate about software quality, automation and technical excellence. This is more than a testing role.

  

You will be a trusted technical leader who helps ensure our products are reliable, safe and ready for release, while driving the future of verification and test automation across our engineering teams.

  

If you enjoy solving complex technical problems, building scalable automation frameworks and influencing engineering decisions through evidence and expertise, we'd love to hear from you.

  

**What you will do**

  

As a **Senior Software Verification Engineer** , you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the quality of innovative software products from concept through to release.

  

You will:

  

* Shape the verification strategy for complex software features, releases and product areas.
* Design and implement robust automated tests that provide confidence in product quality.
* Challenge requirements early to ensure they are clear, testable and aligned to customer needs.
* Investigate complex defects, system behaviours and quality risks.
* Partner closely with Software Engineers, Product Owners, DevOps, Quality and Technical Leaders to deliver high-quality solutions.
* Use your expertise to influence release readiness decisions and product risk management.
* Help evolve our automation frameworks, tools and engineering practices to support faster, smarter and more effective verification.
* Create formal reports of the verification results
Review test code changes from developers  

  

**Drive the future of test automation**

Automation is at the heart of this role.

  

* You'll have the opportunity to design and enhance automated verification solutions using **C++, C#, Python, PowerShell and other modern technologies** , improving both the speed and confidence of software delivery.
You'll work on scalable frameworks, CI/CD integration and advanced testing approaches that support high-quality product development in a highly regulated environment.  

  

**Lead through expertise**

  

* This role offers the opportunity to become a recognised technical leader without moving into formal people management.
* You'll mentor and coach fellow engineers, review verification approaches, promote best practices and help raise the technical capability of the wider team.
Your ability to influence, collaborate and make sound engineering judgments will be just as important as your technical skills.  

  

**What you'll bring**

  

We're interested in talented engineers who combine strong software verification expertise with a passion for continuous improvement.

  

**You'll bring:**

  

* Significant experience in software verification and quality engineering.
* A strong background in test automation and automated framework development.
* Experience with C++ and/or C# and the ability to understand production software.
* Knowledge of scripting languages such as Python or PowerShell.
* Experience designing and executing complex software verification activities.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, particularly when investigating defects and system failures.
* Experience working with CI/CD environments and modern software development practices.
* The ability to guide technical discussions and influence outcomes across multidisciplinary teams.
Master’s or PhD degree in a relevant scientific or engineering discipline (or equivalent). For candidates with degrees obtained outside Belgium, a formal recognition process may be required as part of the hiring journey. Support will be provided.  

  

**Nice to have**

  

You'll stand out if you have experience with:

* Medical device software development.
* Embedded or connected-device products.
* Hardware-software integration testing.
* Hardware-in-the-loop testing.
* Test harnesses, simulation environments or mock frameworks.
Verification tooling, infrastructure and automation framework architecture.  

  

**Why join Cochlear?**

At Cochlear, you'll have the opportunity to work on technology that genuinely improves people's lives while continuing to grow your technical expertise.

This role offers a pathway to becoming a leading specialist in software verification and automation, with opportunities to influence engineering standards, quality strategy and product outcomes on a global scale. You'll work alongside talented engineers in a collaborative environment that values innovation, knowledge sharing and continuous learning.

**Bring your expertise. Help change lives.**

Join a team where quality matters, innovation is encouraged and your technical leadership can make a real difference to the products we create and the people who rely on them.

**What we offer**

An attractive remuneration package and flexible extra-legal benefits

An extensive onboarding and training program

An enjoyable work environment with attention to life-work balance and homeworking

A stimulating environment with growth opportunities and opportunity to meet multi-disciplinary colleagues across the globe

This is your chance to be part of a premier organization with a great culture, working in a dynamic, growing and rapidly evolving environment to deliver outstanding results that benefit our customers every day. Be part of something purposeful and APPLY now by clicking on the link below and see your career grow!

**Cochlear Summary**

Cochlear’s mission is to help people hear and be heard. Around the world, more people chose a Cochlear-branded hearing implant system than any other. Our employees tell us that the number one reason they enjoy working for Cochlear is the opportunity to make a difference to people’s lives. Learn and grow with us as we tackle the most complex challenges in helping people to Hear Now. And Always. Cochlear is the global market leader in implantable hearing solutions including cochlear implant systems (CI) and bone anchored hearing aids (Baha™).

**Equal opportunities**

Cochlear is committed to providing equal opportunities to avoid unlawful discrimination on the grounds of race, sex, disability, sexual orientation, religion/belief or age. In line with our corporate ethics and statutory obligations we strive to ensure that the work environment is free of harassment and bullying and that everyone is treated with dignity and respect - this is an important aspect of ensuring equal opportunities in employment.

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Developer (.NET & Angular)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

**Location:** Seville, Spain (Hybrid / Flexible Remote Policy)  
**Product Area:** PowerLogic Engineering Suite (PLES) / PowerLogic T500 Integration  
**Position Type:** Full-time

### **Job Description**

We are looking for a **Full Stack Software Developer** with experience in both backend and frontend development to join our PowerLogic T500 engineering team in Seville.

The ideal candidate will contribute across the entire software stack, working on desktop and web technologies used to configure, commission, and maintain Schneider Electric's PowerLogic T500 platform within **PowerLogic Engineering Suite (PLES)**. We are looking for engineers who enjoy working across different technical areas and can contribute to all development activities within a cross-functional Agile squad.

### **Responsibilities**

* Develop new features, enhancements, and bug fixes for the PowerLogic T500 engineering and configuration tools.
* Contribute to both frontend and backend development using **Angular**, **TypeScript**, **C#**, and **.NET** technologies.
* Develop and maintain desktop and web-based applications integrated through **Electron**.
* Implement business logic, APIs, data persistence, and user interface components.
* Support real-time communications and device interactions using technologies such as **SignalR** and WebSockets.
* Participate in architecture discussions, technical design, code reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Collaborate with Product Owners and squad members in requirements analysis and feature definition.
* Ensure software quality through automated testing, cybersecurity, and secure development practices.

### **Requirements**

* 3+ years of software development experience.
* Experience developing applications with **C#**, **.NET**, **Angular**, and **TypeScript**.
* Knowledge of relational databases and ORM frameworks such as **PostgreSQL** and **Entity Framework Core**.
* Understanding of modern software engineering practices including Object-Oriented Design, Dependency Injection, and automated testing.
* Familiarity with real-time communication technologies such as SignalR or WebSockets.
* Experience working with Git, Agile/Scrum methodologies, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Ability to work effectively in an international and multi-site environment.
* Good level of English, both written and spoken.

### **Desirable Skills**

* Experience developing desktop applications using **Electron**.
* Knowledge of industrial communication protocols or device integration.
* Experience with cloud, DevOps, containerization, or modern deployment practices.
* Strong collaboration, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Interest in building software solutions for power systems, digital substations, and critical infrastructure.

### **What We Offer**

* Flexible hybrid work model based in Seville.
* Opportunity to work with modern technologies including .NET 8, Angular, PostgreSQL, Electron, and SignalR.
* International collaboration within a global technology leader.
* Continuous learning, career development, and technical growth opportunities.
* The possibility to contribute to innovative solutions supporting the digitalization and sustainability of electrical networks

* Supportive team environment with mentorship to help you grow your technical expertise
